style._about: Look and sound for every stage. Changing anything here marks all assets and scenes for redo.

fonts.headline: Fredoka Bold, or the nearest bold rounded sans available
fonts.body: Inter SemiBold, or the nearest clean sans available
fonts.ui_mockups: Inter or the system sans, so screens look like a real chat app

text_rules.on_screen_text_position: upper third, centred, inside the safe margin
text_rules.captions: bottom centre, 44 px, light text on a 70% black rounded box, max 2 lines of 42 characters

motion_rules: Ease in-out on everything; pops and stamps take 0.25-0.35 s.
Hold every on-screen text line for at least 2 seconds.
No strobing: any flicker stays below 3 flashes per second.
Each scene starts when its voiceover paragraph starts.
Action icons always appear in their action colour, inside a circular badge.
style.art_direction: Flat, friendly cartoon. Simple round avatars with dot eyes only. Night scenes are dark navy, not scary.
brand_rules: Chat screens look like a modern chat app (dark sidebar, channel list, messages) but never use the Discord logo, wordmark or mascot.
The narration may say 'Discord'; the visuals stay generic.
Only the example names from game.json appear on screen.

audio.voice: Calm and slightly dramatic, like a late-night radio host. 48 kHz mono WAV, one file per scene.
audio.music: Low, tense, royalty-free background beat, about 15-20 dB under the voice. Cuts out at the drumroll in scene 13, back for scene 14.
audio.final_loudness: about -16 LUFS integrated, peaks below -1 dBTP

export.scene_clips: 1920x1080, 30 fps, no audio, exactly the scene's duration_s
export.final: H.264 MP4, 1920x1080, 30 fps, high quality (CRF about 18); AAC 48 kHz 192 kbps stereo; captions burned in

assets.description: Simple round player avatar: head, body, arms, legs. Dot eyes, no other facial detail, so nobody looks like a real colleague. Must read clearly at 200 px tall.
variants: 4 colour combos from style.palette (skin tone x shirt) for crowds
poses: standing, sleeping (lying down, zzz), digging, sneaking, startled, climbing, finger-to-lips, holding a tin

assets.description: Classic bandit eye-mask that fits the avatar's head, as its own file so it can drop on and fly off.
Dark silhouette of the avatar (palette.shadow) in a sneaking pose.
Single food tin: gold body (palette.ration_tin), red label band (palette.ration_tin_label). Must read at 48 px.

Five matching icons in circular badges, each in its action colour from style.actions: shovel (scavenge), grabbing hand (steal), shield (guard), magnifying glass (investigate), gift box (gift). Same line weight and corner radius across all five.
Original wordmark 'SURVIVORS' in the headline font, slightly weathered stencil feel, light on navy. Plus a small version for the end card.
Top-down office floor plan at night: about 15 desks in clusters, a few desk lamps that can switch on and off, navy palette.
Small camping tent, top-down at the same angle as the desks so a desk can morph into it, plus a front view with a window.
Row of 10 weekday tiles (Mon-Fri) that can be ticked off one by one.
Friendly rescue helicopter, side view, open door showing 5 seats. Rotor as its own layer so it can spin.
Dented outdoor rubbish bin for the avatar to dig through.
Small slot-machine reel showing the digits 0 to 2 (can also be built from text in EffectCraft).
Moon and sun icons for showing nights passing.
Translucent dome in the guard colour that sits over an avatar.
Cone of light from above for the caught thief.
3 small shield icons in a row; each can be greyed out when used.
Large magnifying glass that sweeps across the scene; the lens area is transparent.
Big rubber stamp 'EXPOSED' in the steal colour, slightly rotated, grungy edges.
Bouncy question mark above a head.
Sealed envelope with a wax seal and the words 'SECRET GOAL'. Never show goal text.
Walkie-talkie icon for the radio channel.
Scoreboard panel with three rows: 'Seat +3', 'Alive, no seat +1' and 'Secret goal +2'.
Red stage curtain in two halves that pulls open to reveal 'THE REVEAL'.
Wall of pinned paper clippings and red string behind the curtain. Clippings only use the example names (RustyKettle, QuietBadger, SoggyBiscuit, LuckyLantern).

Phone frame showing a generic dark chat app on a 'survivors' server: channel list (#town-square, #news, #radio), and a message box with '/steal' being typed and a small command-suggestion popup. No Discord logo or branding.

The #news channel in the same generic chat app. 'Survivors Bot' posts '07:30 MORNING NEWS' with three lines, each its own layer: 'Someone hit RustyKettle overnight. Down 2.' / 'CAUGHT: QuietBadger caught SoggyBiscuit red-handed. SoggyBiscuit pays QuietBadger 2.' / 'LuckyLantern ran out of food.'
The #radio channel with three messages from 'Anonymous', each its own layer: 'SoggyBiscuit was out late last night...' / 'Don't trust the quiet ones.' / 'RustyKettle is lying about their rations.'
Message box with '/join' typed, then the bot replies privately: 'You're in. Your secret alias is RustyKettle. Tell no one. Day 1 starts [LAUNCH DATE] at 07:30.'
